steps: Title screen, Play a seed, typed CA-USA-OLIV1, game opened as US president
Chose Guide me at the familiarity question
Month 1: picked an answer, Choose all recommended, Execute, saw +10 Venezuela view
scenarios.notes: Seed worked at once. First payoff came after about 2.5 minutes, then every month grew to 7-8 things to open.

steps: Looked for a big peace move; found only advisers' small orders (Court Mexico, Spy on Iran, Reform program)
The Iran war ended on its own in month 3 without any choice of mine
scenarios.notes: Never felt I made peace happen.

friction.expected: A code box on the page
friction.happened: Button looked greyed out until I pressed it, then a small box opened under it; I found it but the first look said disabled
Page opened scrolled down with the president's name cut off; mission box and a 7 goals link read like a form
Four columns of text: 3 things list, goals, advisers, what will happen. Three answers with small grey text about hurts and helps; I read only the buttons

friction.expected: Pick the first card (best for mission)
friction.happened: I ended up with Back Rodriguez's process, the card that says Hurts approval; the three Choose buttons look identical so I could not tell which answer I had pressed until the next screen (note: part of this was my own click targeting)
Foreign Minister, Chief of Staff, Intelligence Chief each recommend something different; I could not tell who matters. I pressed Choose all recommended and followed all of them
Big +10 and bar 20 to 30 for Venezuela's view, but the mission line says 20 to 29, needs -10
7 things, 6 recommended, a list of Open buttons; this is the moment I would have closed the tab
Reform program costs 2 and capital is 3, yet the panel said the recommended order does not run (their 2 is not spent); after Choose all it ran and capital showed 1 of 6
Mission: stability 56 to 62%, needs 25%. Higher than needed but one bar is red; I could not tell if good or bad

friction.expected: Result of the thing I did
friction.happened: Text says the war with Iran is over (front 70 to 70) though I never chose anything about Iran; Iran, Mexico, Gaza, Indonesia are names I do not know
Headline is Counter-intelligence sweep, a call I never opened; it was picked for me by Choose all recommended. Calls 2 open stays on top with no way to tell which
I pressed Desk and got a full newspaper page that I had not asked for, with its own Next month button
The decision panel stayed on the left so I lost nothing, but the globe is covered by about 40 round icons I cannot read; top tabs Relations, Regimes, Military mean little

Maduro, Machado, Rodriguez, Modi, Khamenei, Merz, Xi, Gaza stabilization force, defence pacts: unknown to me. Guide me underlines them and the who-is-who row helped at the start, but I never opened an explanation

bugs.title: Choose all recommended answers calls too and the result headline names a call the player never opened
bugs.expected: Calls stay open or the result states which call was answered
bugs.actual: Result headline is for a different crisis (Foreign interference) than the one on screen; chips say Left open: Break the strike

bugs.title: Capital warning contradicts result
steps: Read the If you execute now box
bugs.expected: Reform program runs and says so
bugs.actual: First read says the recommended order does not run (their 2 is not spent); it later ran, capital 3 to 1

suggestions.what: Month desk shows one decision and one big button; hide the list of 7 things behind a small link
One decisive big move per month (end the war, make peace) with a picture of the result, not 6 small orders
Mark the chosen answer on the card immediately and make the best-for-mission card visually bigger
One consistent number for each change, same on bar, big figure and mission line

delight: The seed code box worked first time and put me into the right game
Month 1 result: handshake picture and a huge +10 appeared the moment I pressed Execute (shots/olivia-desk/007-m1result.png)
The globe on the title screen looks beautiful (shots/olivia-desk/001-title.png)

fun.reason: One real payoff in month 1 and a nice picture; after that, sorting 7 things per month felt like homework.

clarity.reason: The big button is clear, but who recommends what, why numbers differ and what Calls open means were not.

visual.reason: Title globe and result scenes are lovely; the desk is dense dark text.

feels_like_a_game.reason: Results feel like a game, the desk feels like a work tool.

agency.reason: I pressed a wrong-looking answer and could not see which until after; choose-all made choices for me.

realism.reason: Names and headlines feel like news, but I cannot judge.

replay.reason: I would go back to my own game.

recommend.reason: I would send it to a friend who likes reading about politics, not to anyone who wants a quick game.

quit_point: Month 2 desk (about 3 minutes in): 7 things to do, 6 recommended orders, 4 columns of text, with no clear single choice
verbatim: The picture and the big plus ten were great. Then I got a list of seven things and I just wanted one button.
